description.en: Interpolates a character's position and Y rotation from a start to an end transform over a number of frames, applying it directly frame by frame via CMND_SET_POSRY (rather than delegating to a native movement command). Note: in this build the rotation clamp branches have a copy-paste bug — they write into the Z-position accumulator instead of the rotation accumulator, so the rotation can overshoot past its clamped end value on the final frames.
Handle of the character to move.
Number of frames to interpolate over.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Interpolate a character's position and rotation over 30 frames
MoveTalkChara(hChara, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0], [10.0, 0.0, 20.0, 90], 30);
